cards.heading: The whole day belongs to Jesus

blocks.text: Workers are typically the first to arrive at church on Sunday morning - often an hour or more before everyone else. This means waking up early to be sure of arriving in good time. As far as workers are concerned, the entirety of Sunday belongs to Jesus Christ.

After morning prayers, workers are expected to go house-to-house witnessing or following up with contacts, inviting people to church. In the evening, they're expected to be present at House Fellowship Centres and at the monthly Holy Communion service.
